_comment: EXACT CORPUS REVISIONS every Clojure measurement in this repository was taken against.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The corpora live outside the repository, under
git checkouts of UPSTREAM projects. Nothing else in the tree recorded which revision
was in use: clj-kondo's SHA appeared in three files by accident, and the other three
appeared nowhere. A fresh clone of `clojure/clojure` yields master, not ec0ae17, so
every gate number in validation/ and every F5/F7 figure becomes irreproducible the
moment that directory is recreated without these pins.
Recorded during the pre-erasure sweep, when the corpus directory was about to be
deleted. This is the last commit that can still observe the checkouts.

clojure.role: primary small corpus; every CLJ-Dxx ruling and both enforced-gate corpora
clojure.restore: git clone https://github.com/clojure/clojure.git && git -C clojure checkout ec0ae1787a688684185e755d53f6d9cb9693f571

clj-kondo.role: small corpus; the only SHA that was already recorded elsewhere in the tree

core.async.role: small corpus; the F5 calls shard
core.async.restore: git clone https://github.com/clojure/core.async.git && git -C core.async checkout 8e6e382d9eefaa3054bfa3834d4e6dbc413cbe2b

metabase.role: large corpus; the second half of every enforced-class gate, and M60
metabase.restore: git clone https://github.com/metabase/metabase.git && git -C metabase checkout 176d0682e28ab55933b8a3d05ae95c19f7a6a2e6

P3D-Legacy.role: vb primary corpus (the historical P3D-Legacy: 1,880 .vb files, the largest VB.NET corpus in the fleet)
P3D-Legacy.restore: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/P3D-Legacy/P3D-Legacy.git P3D-Legacy  # then record `git rev-parse HEAD` and the .vb count; the corpus is 785 MB on disk
P3D-Legacy.measuredAt: 2026-11-01 round 8 (this host; cloned shallow at the HEAD above because the historical checkout was absent)

DISMTools.role: vb second corpus (VB.NET WPF/console application: dependencies, events, overrides and interface implementations in ordinary application shape)
DISMTools.restore: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/CodingWonders/DISMTools.git DISMTools  # then record `git rev-parse HEAD` and the .vb count
DISMTools.measuredAt: 2026-11-01 round 8 (this host; cloned shallow at the HEAD above because the historical checkout was absent)

caveats: The F5 gate enforces per-repo FILE FLOORS (clojure 143, clj-kondo 444, core.async 46, metabase 4253) and exits 3 on a truncated corpus. Those floors were measured against these revisions; a different revision may trip them, and that is the intended behaviour rather than a false alarm.
File counts here are CLOJURE files only (clj/cljc/cljs/edn). The gate's floor counts differ because it counts what the analyzer actually parses.
No Clojure corpus pin existed before this file. If a later lane changes a revision, this file must change with it or every historical figure becomes ambiguous.
